_comment: Best-effort manifest — Anthropic's official plugin spec was not publicly documented at v1.0 ship time. Fields and structure may need adjustment when the official spec lands.
name: harness
description: Factory-Missions-style autonomous coding harness for Claude Code. Provides Orchestrator, Worker, and Validator subagents, slash-skills, and lifecycle hooks for multi-feature missions.
author: Stefano De Grandis
_repository_note: Placeholder URL — update with the actual public repository address when the repo is published.

steps: Copy the .claude/ directory from this repo into the root of your target project.
Open a Claude Code session in your target project — the orchestrator agent activates automatically via .claude/settings.json.
installation.notes: When Anthropic ships official 'claude plugin install' support, this manifest is intended to be compatible with that flow. Until then, the manual copy-of-.claude/ method is the canonical install path.
